title: The River Through Time
note: Cutaway showcase film 1 (geology, time-lapse). A stream on a flat grassy block cuts a canyon through the rock beds over ages; time is shown by the sun racing and the light shifting; an ammonite, a fish and a trilobite are bared in the canyon wall; today: golden hour, a hiker on the rim, birds. Three shots. Blender Cycles, procedural, on the Cutaway kit (films/styles/cutaway) and its cinematic extras. Sound: real nature recordings only (see NOTES.md for the event table).
